sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I2, which must be performed 
on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Abdullah Elsayed M., tested by eng Abdulatif Ahmed, 
revised by quality control eng Adel Abd- El kader El Nagar at EDEPC, 
accepted by eng El Sayed Attiah Abd El Maksood general director, and approved 
by eng. Fathy M Ragab Head Sector of Talkha PS.

هذا 
الوثيقة مقبولة من قبل المهندس. سمير عبد الجليل EDEPC التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة 
المدير العام، منسق MPIS، و 
معتمد من قبل المحاسب محمود سليمان EDEPC المشرف والتفتيش المالي 
مدير عام مراقبة الجودة ومشرف التفتيش والجودة 
السيطرة على قطاع الرأس.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safty category
Safty fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, safety belt ...etc.

 supply of the crane.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Hoist rope : The 
 condition of the wire rope is of prime importance, it should be 
 greased little but often , avoiding the use of lubricants containing 
 petrol.
Rope drum : By hand through the opening above the gearbox.

Rope drum : By hand through the opening above the gearbox.

sections.text: Rope drum : By hand through the opening above the gearbox.

For the flat cable conductor system, remove the track end stop at line 
 start end and withdraw trolleys from track, then apply (MOBIL VACTRA OIL) at 
 50˚c between wheel and trolley frame.

Travel wheels bearings should be packed with the ( MOBILPLEX 48) during 
 wheels assembly.

Inspect and grease the limit switch bar and particularly where it passes 
 through the rope drum and plates ensuring that it slides freely.

Ensure that the push button box is properly suspended by the supporting wire 
 or chain.
التحقق من حالة الناقلات لنظام الموصلات المغلقة.
Ensure all fixing screw of the flexible cable is tight.
Ensure that the moving parts of contactors moving freely.
Check that all terminals and fuses of the transformer are tight.
Check for proper connection and tightness of the terminal block .

Inspect the wire rope carefully. It should be replaced immediately for the 
 least suspicion in its quality (broken wires , permanent deformation and so 
 on ).

Ensure that the rope guide and pressure ring assembly in position without 
 interfering with the passage of the wire rope and that the tension spring is 
 effective.

Ensure that the disc brake is effective. Examine the disc for any 
 uneven wear.
